The '''Shaltin Tunnels''' were a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. While in the Corporate Sector, the Tunnels skirted the [[Thandon Cluster]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The route was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Listehol Campaign|campaign]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
